1. Likely answer or root cause
When the agent uses all of its allowed investigation steps (`MAX_STEPS = 10`), it is prompted to stop calling tools and provide its best final answer using the evidence gathered so far. Specifically, a follow-up user message is appended instructing the model not to call any more tools and to format its final answer while noting in section 3 that the investigation was cut short and what could not be verified. The investigation status returned is set to `"step_limit_reached"`, with `MAX_STEPS` steps and the generated text as the answer.

```python
        "Using only what you have gathered so far, give your best answer in the same format, "
        "and say clearly in section 3 that the investigation was cut short and what you could not verify."
    ))
    final = llm.generate(contents, system, TOOL_DECLARATIONS, allow_tools=False)
    return {"status": "step_limit_reached", "steps": MAX_STEPS, "answer": llm.get_text(final) or None}
```
